messages:
Marco (Ops): FYI — NexaSupply reports 6/32 H100s from last shipment DOA on arrival. They propose 2 immediate air replacements and the rest via sea consolidator. Need routing + billing decision. :warning:
Jin (Infra): Oof. Which racks affected? Can we triage to non-critical clusters?
Marco (Ops): A handful of prod inference pods in eu-west-1 and one staging pool in us-west-2. We can throttle/cordon some jobs.
Elena (Procurement): @Rory what’s the guaranteed lead time for replacements if we go air vs sea? Also what about insurance claim for the DOA units?
Rory - NexaSupply: Sorry about the hit — we can air 2 units out of AMS tomorrow (next-day air), sea for the remaining 4 on the next consolidated container (ETA ~12 days). We’ll open an insurance claim for the damaged units; need serials + photos. We can credit 25% of freight premium if Redwood covers the rest of expedite fee.
Alex (Supply): Can we move 2 eu pool loaners to eu-west-1 to cover immediate capacity while replacements arrive? That reduces criticality.
Jin (Infra): Yes, we have 2 spare loaners in FRA staging. They need 1hr prep and routing. That covers the eu cluster short-term. Still short in us-west-2.
Marco (Ops): Ops-Bot please create a hardware incident and tag affected routes.
Ops-Bot: created HW-INC-2026-042, assigned to @Jin and @Alex. AWB prep checklist posted.
Elena (Procurement): If Nexa gives 25% credit on expedite, can we ask for 50% given this is a partially DOA pallet? Also confirm who pays customs duties for air vs sea — that changes net cost.
Rory - NexaSupply: I can escalate on credit to 40% but need approval from logistics manager. For duties: standard incoterm same as contract (DAP) — Redwood pays duties unless we change terms. We can route DDP for air at our cost if you accept 3% surcharge on unit price to cover broker fees.
Marco (Ops): Cost tradeoff: air = ~+$12k premium + faster repair; sea = +12 days but cheaper. If we lose SLAs on inference in us-west-2, cost of degraded serving >> shipping.
Jin (Infra): Can we reroute some traffic to eu or asia mirrors temporarily? There’s ~18% latency penalty for some customers but it prevents tail errors.
Elena (Procurement): Let's negotiate: Nexa air 3 units (not 2) to cover us-west + eu loaner rotation, vendor picks customs brokerage (DDP) for those 3, vendor backs 40% expedite credit, vendor covers insurance deductible. For remaining 3, sea consolidate with next container and vendor covers freight on damaged unit replacement.
Rory - NexaSupply: I can propose that upstream. Need written approval by EOD to lock air slots.
Alex (Supply): Confirming loaner move — I’ll kick off transfer of 2 FRA loaners to eu-west-1 now, ETA ~6 hours to be ready. us-west still uncovered unless we get 1 air unit.
Marco (Ops): Jin — please throttle non-critical batch jobs in us-west-2 and flip some replica traffic to eu for low-priority customers. Monitor error budget.
Jin (Infra): On it. Will post the traffic shift plan in eng-oncall.
Elena (Procurement): @Rory please send a formal quote for 3-air-DDP + 3-sea-ETA, the proposed 40% expedite credit, and insurance terms. We need invoice breakdown (unit cost, freight, duties, broker fees) to approve.
Rory - NexaSupply: Will send quote within 90 minutes. Also attaching placeholder AWBs for the air slots once confirmed:
```
AWB: NX123AMS0001 (air x3 tentative)
AWB: NXSEA456789 (sea consolidate)
```
LogisticsBot: Note — customs hold risk for air into US-West due to recent broker backlog. Add 12-24h buffer to ETA.
Marco (Ops): Decision: provisionally approve 3-air-DDP if quote matches terms (vendor covers broker + 40% expedite credit). Elena to sign purchase amendment after review. Jin & Alex to execute loaner move + throttle plan. Everyone update this thread after quote and once AWBs are final. :white_check_mark:
